Who will win this race? Betfair Non-Runner Rule applies. Reduction factors may be updated periodically at the discretion of Betfair based on trading in the market, but after approximately 5 minutes from scheduled ‘off’ time of a given race, they will be updated only in exceptional circumstances. This market will turn IN PLAY at the off with all unmatched bets cancelled once the Betfair SP reconciliation process has been completed. Betting will be suspended at the end of the race.
